doc.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Opening at Clearwater Beach after the Alden-Barrett set
summary: Rowe opens the interview after hearing Tate play with Dan Barrett and Howard Alden; they talk about the rehearsal and complex arrangements.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Clearwater Beach. I’m really pleased to have bassist Frank Tate with me here today. And I just heard a fantastic set of music with some of your cohorts, Dan Barrett and Howard Alden.
I’d have to share your enthusiasm for it. We haven’t worked together in a long time.
Well we rehearsed this afternoon so we get a little rust off, you know, scratching barnacles.
But those are some kind of complex arrangements but you pull them off pretty easily. Do you play differently with that group?
